'''Stabilizing motivators''' were components used in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transport]]. One of the [[Factory/Legends|factories]] that produced stabilizing motivators was located in [[Zone Five]] in [[Gallisport]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shesharile 5]].
